description: Interface definition for the Quest Engine
purpose: Generates quests from ASH cosmic patterns with multiple completion paths and narrative consequences

methods.name: generate_quest
methods.description: Generate a quest from a cosmic pattern and player state

methods.name: get_completion_paths
methods.description: Return available completion paths for a quest

methods.name: complete_quest
methods.description: Complete a quest via a chosen path and return consequences

methods.name: build_quest_chain_manifest
methods.description: Create QuestChainManifest with multiple StageManifest routes from ASH provenance.

invariants: All quests derive from ASH patterns
Every quest has at least two completion paths
Quest completion always produces narrative consequences
CosmicPatternSnapshot and DiagnosticEnvelope provenance is required for meaningful generation.
GenerationPlan is required before any materialized output.
source_ash_refs, diagnostic_ref, and generation_plan_ref must remain traceable.

inputs.name: cosmic_pattern_snapshot
inputs.description: CosmicPatternSnapshot required by ASH generation contract.

inputs.name: diagnostic_envelope
inputs.description: DiagnosticEnvelope required by ASH generation contract.

inputs.name: generation_plan
inputs.description: GenerationPlan required by ASH generation contract.

outputs.name: quest_chain_manifest
outputs.description: QuestChainManifest emitted under ASH generation contract.

outputs.name: quest_resolution_payload
outputs.description: QuestResolutionPayload emitted under ASH generation contract.

outputs.name: worldstate_delta_packet
outputs.description: WorldstateDeltaPacket emitted under ASH generation contract.

ash_alignment_contract.math_basis: F2^9 full-state ASH vector with exactly 16 canonical codewords and x' = x XOR c transitions
ash_alignment_contract.truth_boundary: GenerationPlan may guide materialization; downstream engines and adapters must not author ASH truth or YWE domain truth.
